title: Add a low-stock notification when inventory falls below threshold
intent: Add a low-stock notification whenever inventory falls below the configured threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Decreasing stock to at or below the configured low-stock threshold emits a low-inventory notification
Decreasing stock to a level above the threshold does not emit a notification
Existing stock increase/decrease behavior is unaffected
expected_risks: NotificationService.notify_low_inventory and config.low_stock_threshold already exist and work — this is primarily a wiring change in InventoryService.decrease_stock
A notification could fire repeatedly on every decrease while already below threshold unless explicitly bounded (acceptable for this demo scope)
expected_tests: decreasing stock below threshold emits a low-inventory notification
decreasing stock while staying above threshold emits no notification
